caseName: St. Paul & Tacoma Lumber Co. v. Northern Pacific Railway Co.
caseNameFull: St. Paul & Tacoma Lumber Company v. Northern Pacific Railway Company
attorneys: Messrs. Alexander Britton, Charles W. Bunn, L. B. da Ponte and Dennis F. Lyons for the appellee, in support of the motion., Mr. Benjamin S. Grosscup for the appellant, in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want, of jurisdiction, upon the authority of Southern Pacific Ry. Co. v. Stewart, 254 U. S. 359; Barnett v. Kunkel, 264 U. S. 16.
